author: Fredericksburg Leader
title: 68 American Indian students enrolled in Stafford County school districts in 2023-24 school year
text: \u003chtml\u003e\u003chead\u003e\u003ctitle\u003e\u003c/title\u003e\u003cstyle\u003e\u003c/style\u003e\u003c/head\u003e\u003cbody\u003e\u003cp\u003eThere were 68 American Indian students enrolled in Stafford County school districts in the 2023-24 school year, 4.6% more than the previous year, according to the \u003ca href='https://www.doe.virginia.gov/'\u003eVirginia Department of Education\u003c/a\u003e.\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003eData showed that Stafford County school districts welcomed 31,700 students during the 2023-24 school year. Among them, American Indian students comprised 0.2% of the student body to be the least represented ethnicity in the county's school districts.\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003eStafford County Public Schools has a main office in Stafford and is the only school district within Stafford County.\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003eAs of November 2023, according to \u003ca href='https://www.publicschoolreview.com/average-student-teacher-ratio-stats/national-data'\u003ePublic School Review\u003c/a\u003e, in the 2023-24 school year, Virginia public schools saw an average student-to-teacher ratio of approximately 1:14, which is better than the national average of 1:15 in public schools.\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003cdiv\u003e\u003cstrong style='font-size: 18px;'\u003eEthnicities in Stafford County in 2023-24 School Year\u003c/strong\u003e\u003c/div\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003e\u003csvg viewBox='0 0 600 300' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' xmlns:xlink='http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink' xmlns:a3='http://ns.adobe.com/AdobeSVGViewerExtensions/3.0/' a3:scriptImplementation='Adobe'\u003e\u003cdefs\u003e\u003cfilter id='dropshadow' width='1.2' height='1.2'\u003e\u003cfeGaussianBlur stdDeviation='4' result='blur'/\u003e\u003c/filter\u003e\u003cstyle type='text/css'\u003e\u003c![CDATA[/* Copy from here for external style sheet */.svgBackground{ fill:# ;}.graphBackground{ fill:# ;}/* graphs titles */.mainTitle{ text-anchor: middle; fill: rgb(75, 75, 75); font-size: 16px; font-family: \"Arial\
